info.name: Task Management API Regression Suite
info.description: Derived from project implementation. Run requests in listed order; some edge branches require mocked tests.

item.name: Update task with itself as parent
Text containing 1st resolves to the upcoming first day

exec: pm.test('due date is today if today is the first, otherwise next month first',()=>{const now=new Date();const monthOffset=now.getUTCDate()===1?0:1;const expected=new Date(Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(),now.getUTCMonth()+monthOffset,1)).toISOString().slice(0,10);pm.expect(pm.response.json().due_date).to.eql(expected);});

item.name: Specific ISO date is not parsed
Empty output / serializer / DB failure branches (manual injection)
item.description: HTTP inputs cannot force empty breakdown output or save-time DB failure. Mock break_down_task or inject a DB failure to verify 502 and transaction rollback.

item.name: Same body different key creates another ID
Failed keyed request is not cached
Breakdown same key with different body conflicts
Invalid completed filter returns validation envelope

exec: pm.test("standard completed validation envelope",()=>{const j=pm.response.json();pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("VALIDATION_ERROR");pm.expect(j.error.message).to.eql("Validation failed");pm.expect(j.error.details).to.eql([{field:"completed",issue:"Must be 'true' or 'false'."}]);});
